headline: STOP

scenes.say: Stop guessing their exact cards. That's how amateurs lose.
Pros think in ranges: every hand the opponent could have here, and how many ways to have it.
A pair can be dealt {aa} ways. Ace-king offsuit: {ako} ways.
This range has {total} combos. {strong} are strong.
You don't need to know their hand. You need the odds, and the best move against all of it.
scenes.show: The best move against all of it.

scenes.say: Off the table too: don't ask what will happen. Ask what could, and how often.
